email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Maxwell, saw dbt Labs just closed the Fivetran merger to build the data layer for trusted AI agents.

Integrating two GTM orgs usually means more Southeast accounts in play than reps can cover while territories get redrawn, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your Southeast region off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Maxwell, quick follow-up on the Southeast region.

Post-merger, the new combined number tends to land before coverage models catch up, and most teams cannot say how many meetings each rep needs to hit it. The gap shows up late, and by then it is a scramble to save the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your Southeast team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Maxwell, last bit of proof.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how a region like yours compares to other high-growth data companies on reply rate. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Maxwell, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling Southeast pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most mid-integration, and I know merging two motions is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise data motion? I will tailor it to your region either way.
